business_summary: Immuno-Biological Laboratories Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and supply of various immunological research reagents internationally. The company offers ELILSA, an assay kit to quantitatively measure targeted substances; and supports research services on Alzheimer's disease, metabolic syndrome, and cancer, as well as customized services for production of customized antibodies and development of ELISA test kits, antibodies, synthetic peptides, cell culture-related reagents, and contract services such as antibody preparation, purification and labeling, protein production by cell culture, and development of antibody-based measurement systems. It also provides LipoSEARCH, a customized service for profiling and analyzing lipoprotein through gel-filtration, a high-performance liquid chromatography method that can profile various clinical samples, such as tiny plasma or serum samples from both small animals and human beings for a broad range of research fields including lipid metabolism, development of drugs for life-style related diseases, development of functional supplemental foods, and clinical studies. In addition, the company offers LipoTEST, a support tool for diagnostic and health checks at animal clinics; and customized biomarker testing services for lifestyle-related diseases. Further, it operates a protein production business using transgenic silkworms for manufacturing of antibodies for research reagents and diagnostic products; human collagen for cosmetic materials; development of proteins for use in drugs; and other protein production. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Fujioka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Immuno-Biological Laboratories Co., Ltd.는 국제적으로 다양한 면역학 연구 시약의 연구, 개발, 제조 및 공급에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 표적 물질을 정량적으로 측정하는 분석 키트인 ELILSA를 제공합니다. 알츠하이머병, 대사증후군, 암에 대한 연구서비스와 맞춤형 항체 생산 및 ELISA 검사키트 개발, 항체, 합성펩타이드, 세포배양 관련 시약 개발을 위한 맞춤형 서비스, 항체 조제, 정제 및 라벨링, 세포배양에 의한 단백질 생산, 항체 기반 측정시스템 개발 등의 위탁서비스를 지원합니다. 또한, 지질 대사, 생활습관 질환 치료제 개발, 기능성 식품 개발, 임상 연구 등 광범위한 연구 분야에 대해 작은 동물과 인간의 작은 혈장 또는 혈청 시료 등 다양한 임상 시료를 프로파일링할 수 있는 고성능 액체 크로마토그래피 방식인 겔여과(gel-filtration)를 통해 지질단백질을 프로파일링하고 분석하는 맞춤형 서비스인 LipoSEARCH를 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 지원 서비스인 LipoTEST를 제공합니다.
